scope: Complete source field semantics and data representation; no storage adapter or playable restore.

phases.semantics: Filename guard, then version guard before getLocal; timer/progress then identity.
Exact load setter names and order; source capacities overwritten by maxima; rank/job derived values overwritten by saved bonuses.
Clear, construct each stored pet, checkUp again, afterAdd; source constructor object repeats nextLvRate three times. Constructor refills life; no saved deployment.
Backpack 1..40, shortcuts 1..7, warehouse 1..54, six equipment slots, bells 1..3, crafting slots; empty/missing type goes through empty-slot branch.
Current building order levels then prizeLv; shop unlock counts. Source loop guard counter never increments.
Current NPC table order; nTitle/cmd/oldCmd always assigned; other fields only for nonempty defined saved name.
Main, branch, dare, daily flags; only active daily objectives rebuilt; four named daily tasks keep their objective identity.
Current skill table length, addSkill(saved name, level), no blanket clear here.
Clear friends, optional lover lookup, capacity, addFriend by nTitle then upData; resolve after NPC restoration.
Boss progression by current index; map and paired coordinates; missing coordinate chooses entry1.
XP fields and six visibility values independently; title counts then PK flags.
Older source version applies shop capacity/unlock adjustments.
Detach SharedObject, message, equipment.flashAttribute (calls role.flashAttribute), task.showTask. Map frame2 then changeDepth/gotoAndStop/debug.
